I told Hollis in his thread in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing newer in the channel changes it.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only gave him what he can already read there. A seat count is account information, not a money figure, so no approval was needed. There are no Marrow Agrisupply files in the share to check it against. In the reply I suggested Hollis confirm with Tobias if it may have changed.
